description: Source code implementing session management functions for a JavaScript engine, including session creation, start, data get/set, status, ID retrieval, and destruction, with file-based storage in /tmp.

methods.name: session_start
methods.description: Starts a session by checking existing session ID or creating a new one based on cookies.

methods.name: session_create
methods.description: Creates a new session with a random session ID.

methods.name: session_get_data
methods.description: Retrieves session data from file and loads into a JavaScript object.

methods.name: session_set_data
methods.description: Saves JavaScript object data into session file.

methods.name: session_get_status
methods.description: Returns whether a session is active.

methods.name: session_destroy
methods.description: Destroys the current session and deletes session file.

methods.name: ccsp_session_module_open
methods.description: Initializes the session module and exposes functions to JavaScript.
